Antinsky W80 is especially recommended for applications such as bracelets, large pendants, medals, coins, jewellery designs, and other metal casting parts. blocks.text: Shake the liquid resin before use. Clean the resin tank and the molding platform to keep the bottom of the resin tank in good condition for light transmission.

After printing, please use the matching tools for post-processing, including blade, diagonal pliers, tweezers, containers, gloves; ethanol(≥95%), lactate, or isopropyl alcohol cleaning solution;
A. Remove the printed model from the molding platform with a blade.
B. Submerge the model in the cleaning solution, rinse or ultrasonically wash, then take out and drain; ANYCUBlC Wash and Cure machines are suggested to ensure better effect.
C.Proper processing, such as removing support, polishing, coloring, etc.
The ideal condition for storing uncured resin is a cool, dark place at room temperature and protected from light to avoid high temperature or sunlight.
Suggested operating temperature is 18-35°C, and a low temperature may affect the printing effect; thus, the resin can be properly preheated before use (not more than 60°C).
If the resin pigment settles, it can be used after stirring or shaking.
In order to ensure the performance of the resin, please take out the model in time after cleaning to avoid the model soaking in water for a long time.
To ensure the mechanical properties of the model, please perform post-curing in time after cleaning and drying.
To ensure the ideal performance of the curable material, it is necessary to control the intensity and time of the light source after curing. Therefore, the following steps are recommended:
(1) The intensity of the mercury lamp or LED light source is 5-10 mW/m², and the duration is no more than 1 hour (self-regulation);
(2)The exposure time in the sun (summer) is around 1 hour;
(3) Proximity or long-term exposure under strong light sources such as high-power high-pressure mercury lamps is prohibited.
(4) It is recommended to print in a dark room or be covered with a lid while printing, as resin is a photosensitive material.

The Original Prusa MK4S delivers reliable results for all your projects. Building on the MK4 model loved by hobbyists and big companies alike, it offers even higher accuracy and print speed. Thanks to its new 360° cooling, high-flow nozzle, and numerous firmware optimizations, you’ll get your 3D models fast and with top-notch quality.

The MK4S answers your needs whether you’re just starting or have years of experience. We’ve designed the UI to be easy to use even for complete beginners, yet its reliable performance also makes it a perfect fit for professional workshops. Getting started is super easy: simply take the MK4S out of the box, plug it in, perform a quick calibration, and start printing in 15 minutes!

While the MK4S is our fastest printer yet, it never sacrifices quality for quicker print times. Thanks to its fine-tuned features and workflow, it always delivers precise models at amazing speeds as confirmed by the perfect 30/30 score in Print Quality in TechRadar’s review.

Your creations should turn out precisely as designed, especially when they require a perfect fit. The MK4S ensures that by delivering exceptionally accurate prints. See the accuracy comparison measured using a CT scan:

Reduce the need for supports and print quicker with less material! Thanks to the 360° cooling, the MK4S allows you to print overhangs of up to 75° without supports, significantly cutting down on print costs and time. This also simplifies printing flexible materials like TPU, where removing supports is often a challenge.

With the MK4S, you get prints that last. Its new cooling fan and high-flow nozzle provide excellent layer adhesion, making your entire prints strong and durable. It comes with a wide array of print profiles that let you prioritize higher speed or maximal sturdiness.

Your models turn out smooth and a joy to look at, as the MK4S’ print profiles prioritize perfect surface finishes. You can adjust print layer height to match your desired level of detail and print everything from super intricate models (with the 0.25mm nozzle) to larger objects, where details matter less
The MK4S prints require low-to-no finishing.

As Tom’s Hardware puts it: The Prusa MK4S is pretty darn fast. It substantially cuts print times thanks to the new cooling fan with a powerful turbine and 360° air delivery, as well as the high-flow nozzle that allows for maximized filament flow. Combined with optimized firmware and print profiles, the results are both quick and flawless.
Real-life comparison of different print speeds.

We ship around 10,000 3D printers each month directly from our HQ in Prague, Czech Republic, and we also started manufacturing them in the USA. There are over half a million Original Prusa printers in the wild and still only around 20 printers per month need to be sent back to us for hands-on maintenance – the claim rate is less than 1%! Don’t believe it? Check out our Trustpilot score or Google Reviews!
Do you want to learn more about the MK4S?

You can control your printer(s) remotely. The MK4S includes an ethernet port and Wi-Fi with NFC setup, allowing you to manage it from anywhere using the secure Prusa Connect system or mobile app. For maximum security, the printer can also operate fully offline.

Choose the best filament for your model, the MK4S can handle most of them: PLA, PETG, ASA, carbon-filled filaments, and even the flexible TPU! With its direct drive Nextruder, it tackles TPU easily, allowing you to create amazing flexible projects. To get the most out of your materials, house the MK4S in an Enclosure.

The Original prusa MK4S kit is compatible with two new optional addons for enthusiasts and modders. First, the GPIO “hackerboard” allows you to control external electronics using G-commands. And we have also introduced an accelerometer addon for those who made extensive changes to the Nextruder. You can find more details on their respective product pages.

Every Original Prusa 3D printer receives long-term support for years after launch. Not just small bugfixes, but major firmware and hardware upgrades that bring useful new features. And MK4 is no exception.
Compared to the Original Prusa MK4, the MK4S brings the following innovations:
Native iOS/Android Prusa app for iOS and Android with easy Wi-Fi setup with an NFC tap
New parts printed from Prusament PC Blend Carbon Fiber or injection molded
Optional accessory: accelerometer for printer modders

* With the MK4S/MMU3 bundle, you will receive both nozzles in the package – the standard and the high-flow nozzle. Assembled MK4S in a bundle with MMU3, the standard nozzle will be pre-installed on the printer by default. See more details in the description in the Addons section.

Our machines are built to last. We operate a massive print farm with over 700 of our printers running 24/7. This means we design our machines to withstand non-stop operation with minimal downtime. The open “bed-slinger“ design is the result of a 10-year evolution and enables the easiest access to all parts without a lengthy disassembly process. No welded or glued parts, everything can be taken apart with a set of Allen keys.

The MK4S has been designed for native offline use, so if you don’t want to use the network services, you don’t have to. The printer can be configured completely without internet access and there are no drawbacks or limitations. The Wi-Fi module can be easily unplugged for environments that require the highest level of security.

name: MK8 Pointed Titanium Alloy Nozzle –M6 Thread ,1.75/0.4mm

blocks.text: The MK8 Pointed Titanium Alloy nozzle is a cutting-edge component designed for 3D printers, known for its exceptional features and specifications. This nozzle is an essential part of the extrusion system, ensuring precise and efficient material deposition. Here’s a detailed description of its key features and specifications:

Outstanding Mechanical Properties: The MK8 Pointed Titanium Alloy nozzle boasts exceptional mechanical properties, providing durability and reliability. It can withstand the rigors of 3D printing without wearing out quickly.

High Specific Strength: Thanks to its titanium alloy construction, this nozzle offers high specific strength, meaning it can withstand considerable stress while remaining lightweight. This results in more precise and efficient printing.

Low Thermal Conductivity: Titanium alloys have a relatively low thermal conductivity, which is advantageous for 3D printing. This property helps maintain a stable temperature within the nozzle, ensuring consistent and controlled extrusion of the printing material.

Smooth Inner Wall: The nozzle’s inner wall is meticulously crafted to be smooth and free of burrs. This design minimizes friction and resistance, allowing for smoother filament flow during the printing process. As a result, it contributes to more precise and clean prints.

Low Viscosity Coefficient: The nozzle’s low viscosity coefficient ensures that the printing material flows smoothly through it. This reduces the risk of clogs and interruptions in the printing process, leading to a more efficient and hassle-free experience.

Flat Contact Surface: The contact surface of the nozzle is flat, effectively addressing the issue of filament leakage. This design prevents any unwanted material seepage and ensures that the printhead remains free from leaks, further enhancing the quality of your 3D prints.
Name: MK8 Pointed Titanium Alloy Nozzle

Filament Compatibility: This nozzle is designed to work with 1.75mm filaments, including PLA, ABS, TPU, and PETG. Its versatility makes it suitable for a wide range of 3D printing projects, allowing you to choose the material that best suits your needs.

Shake the liquid resin before use;

Select the correct print parameters and settings for printing.

ethanol(≥95%),lactate or isopropyl alcohol cleaning solution;
A. Remove the printed model from the molding platform with a blade;
B. Submerge the model in the cleaning solution, rinsed or ultrasonically washed, then taken
out and drained; ANYCUBlC Wash and Cure machines are suggested to ensure better effect.

The ideal condition for storing uncured resin is a cool, dark place at room temperature and protect from light
to avoid high temperature or sunlight.
Suggested operating temperature is 18-35’c, and a low temperature may affect the printing effect, thus, the
resin can be properly preheated before use (not more than 60°C).
If the resin pigment settles, it can be used after stirring or shaking.
In order to ensure the performance of the resin, please take out the model in time after cleaning to avoid the model soaking in water for a long time.
To ensure the mechanical properties of the model, please perform post-curing in time after cleaning and drying.
To ensure the ideal performance of the curable material, it is necessary to control the intensity and time of the
light source after curing.Therefore, the following steps are recommended:
(1) The intensity of mercury lamp or LeD light source is 5-10mW/m?, and the duration is no more than 1 hour (self-regulation);
(2)The exposure time in the sun (summer) is around 1 hour;
(3) Proximity or long-term exposure under strong light sources such as high-power high-pressure mercury
(4) lt is recommended to print in a dark room or be covered with a lid while printing as resin is a photosensitive

The application process of 3D printing temporary dental crowns using resin involves the following steps:
Scanning the patient’s teeth and gums using a 3D scanner or dental impressions.
Designing a 3D model of the tooth using CAD/CAM software based on the scans.
Slicing the 3D model into layers and preparing it for printing.
Printing the model layer by layer using dental crown resin.
Washing and curing the printed model to remove excess resin and harden it.
Polishing the crown to give it a smooth texture.
Applying a layer of glaze or enamel to the crown for added protection and natural appearance.
Disinfecting the crown to ensure it is safe for use.
Fitting the temporary dental crown onto the patient’s tooth.
Temporarily cementing the crown onto the tooth until a permanent crown can be made and installed.

blocks.text: The MK8 Pointed Titanium Alloy nozzle is a cutting-edge component designed for 3D printers, known for its exceptional features and specifications. High Specific Strength: Thanks to its titanium alloy construction, this nozzle offers high specific strength, meaning it can withstand considerable stress while remaining lightweight. This results in more precise and efficient printing.

Low Thermal Conductivity: Titanium alloys have a relatively low thermal conductivity, which is advantageous for 3D printing. This property helps maintain a stable temperature within the nozzle, ensuring consistent and controlled extrusion of the printing material.

Smooth Inner Wall: The nozzle’s inner wall is meticulously crafted to be smooth and free of burrs. This design minimizes friction and resistance, allowing for smoother filament flow during the printing process. As a result, it contributes to more precise and clean prints.

Low Viscosity Coefficient: The nozzle’s low viscosity coefficient ensures that the printing material flows smoothly through it. This reduces the risk of clogs and interruptions in the printing process, leading to a more efficient and hassle-free experience.

Flat Contact Surface: The contact surface of the nozzle is flat, effectively addressing the issue of filament leakage. This design prevents any unwanted material seepage and ensures that the printhead remains free from leaks, further enhancing the quality of your 3D prints.

The Anycubic Photon M3 Max & Photon M3 Plus Auto-Feed Bottle Cap is an original replacement accessory designed for the automatic resin-feeding systems of the Anycubic Photon M3 Max and Photon M3 Plus LCD resin 3D printers. This component provides the dedicated bottle interface used by the compatible auto-feed assembly, supporting the controlled delivery of liquid photopolymer resin from the resin bottle to the printer’s resin vat.

Designed for users who need to replace a missing, damaged, or worn original bottle cap, this accessory helps restore the bottle connection required for the printer’s automatic resin replenishment system. When installed as part of a compatible and functional auto-feed assembly, the system can replenish resin when the vat level becomes insufficient and stop feeding once the required level is reached.

The bottle cap is particularly useful for extended resin-printing jobs, where maintaining an adequate supply of resin helps reduce the need for repeated manual refilling. It is intended for replacement and maintenance purposes and should be used with the appropriate Anycubic auto-feed components.
Original Anycubic Accessory: Designed for the compatible auto-feed system used by the Photon M3 Max and Photon M3 Plus.
Automatic Resin-Feeding Compatibility: Provides the bottle interface required by the compatible automatic resin-supply assembly.

Replacement and Maintenance: Suitable for replacing a missing or damaged bottle cap without necessarily replacing the entire auto-feed assembly.
Model-Specific Compatibility: Intended for the Photon M3 Max and Photon M3 Plus versions of the auto-feed system.
Practical Accessory Design: Supplied as a separate component for servicing or restoring the compatible resin-feeding setup.

It offers a build volume of approximately 300 × 298 × 164 mm (14.7 litres) and a listed maximum printing speed of up to 60 mm/h. Its large printing capacity makes a reliable resin supply particularly useful for larger models and extended printing projects.

The Photon M3 Plus is an LCD resin 3D printer featuring a 9.25-inch 6K monochrome LCD screen with a resolution of 5,760 × 3,600 pixels. It provides a build volume of approximately 197 × 122 × 245 mm (5.9 litres), an XY resolution of 34 microns, and a listed maximum printing speed of up to 100 mm/h. Its automatic resin-feeding system is designed to replenish the vat when resin levels become insufficient.
The Auto-Feed Bottle Cap described here is the specific accessory variant listed by Anycubic for both printers.

blocks.text: The main functions and controls of BLTouch are the same as the usual auto bed leveling sensor, consisting of RC servo and microswitch. Thus, BLTouch can be applied on almost every board.

BLTouch is fulfilled with simple structure and high precision by using progressively designed solenoid and hall sensors. It aims for user convenience and enjoyable printing by adding many smart functions, such as self-test, alarm, alarm release & Touch Switch mode, Blue LED for servo signal indicating and Z-probe (Zmin) Testing.​
BLTouch consists of Atmel ATtiny13A, solenoid, and a push pin.​

Innovative Solenoid: Ultra Power Saving In an idle state, while the push-pin is pulled out or retracted, there is no electric current flowing on the solenoid. Standby electric current in the whole device is below the average of 15mA on working state, but while the pin is moving, in a sudden about 100ms, under 300mA flows in the device. Low power consumption even drops joule heating, and it prevents heart problems.

Hall Sensor: Free Bed Selection BLTouch does not use either optical or proximity(inductive/capacitive) sensors. BLTouch is controlled by the hall effect, providing high precision. Thus, the bed material can be freely selected.
Optimized structure: Larger Build Size BLTouch is a small, and technology-intensive device. Build size can be set larger than other existing auto bed leveling sensors.
Easy to Use: BLTouch uses existing RC Servo motor signals intactly, so just plug BLTouch on the same pins after removing the servo motor.

blocks.text: Arduino Uno is a microcontroller board based on the ATmega328P (datasheet). It has 14 digital input/output pins (of which 6 can be used as PWM outputs), 6 analog inputs, a 16 MHz ceramic resonator (CSTCE16M0V53-R0), a USB connection, a power jack, an ICSP header and a reset button. It contains everything needed to support the microcontroller; simply connect it to a computer with a USB cable or power it with a AC-to-DC adapter or battery to get started.. You can tinker with your Uno without worrying too much about doing something wrong, worst case scenario you can replace the chip for a few dollars and start over again.

“Uno” means one in Italian and was chosen to mark the release of Arduino Software (IDE) 1.0. The Uno board and version 1.0 of Arduino Software (IDE) were the reference versions of Arduino, now evolved to newer releases. The Uno board is the first in a series of USB Arduino boards, and the reference model for the Arduino platform; for an extensive list of current, past or outdated boards see the Arduino index of boards.
The Getting Started with Arduino Uno page contains all the information you need to configure your board, use the Arduino Software (IDE), and start tinkering with coding and electronics.
From the Tutorials section you can find examples from libraries and built-in sketches as well other useful information to expand your knowledge of the Arduino hardware and software.
Find inspiration for your Uno projects from our tutorial platform Project Hub.

blocks.text: High-Toughness PLA for Functional and Mechanical Parts

eSUN PLA-ST is a specially engineered tough PLA filament designed to provide exceptional impact resistance, high elongation at break, and superior layer bonding while maintaining the easy printability of standard PLA. Combining the printing convenience of PLA with toughness that surpasses PETG, PLA-ST is an ideal material for functional prototypes, mechanical components, structural parts, and precision engineering applications.

Unlike standard PLA, PLA-ST is formulated to withstand greater stress and impact without breaking easily. Its enhanced flexibility and durability make it suitable for parts that require both strength and dimensional accuracy. With significantly improved impact resistance and elongation properties, PLA-ST can absorb shocks and mechanical loads more effectively than conventional PLA materials.

PLA-ST offers a unique balance between strength, toughness, and printability. While PETG is often chosen for durable prints, PLA-ST delivers even greater toughness while retaining the excellent surface quality, dimensional stability, and ease of printing associated with PLA. This makes it an excellent choice for users seeking reliable mechanical performance without the challenges commonly associated with PETG printing.

Engineered for stable extrusion and strong layer adhesion, PLA-ST produces smooth, accurate prints with minimal warping. The material delivers consistent feeding, excellent dimensional stability, and high printing accuracy, allowing users to create detailed parts with professional-quality finishes.

Manufactured with strict quality control standards, PLA-ST features consistent diameter tolerance and uniform material composition for dependable printing results. The filament flows smoothly through the extruder, reducing the risk of clogs and ensuring successful prints even during long printing sessions.

Innovative Solenoid: Ultra Power Saving In an idle state, while the push-pin is pulled out or retracted, there is no electric current flowing on the solenoid. Standby electric current in the whole device is below the average of 15mA on working state, but while the pin is moving, in a sudden about 100ms, under 300mA flows in the device. Low power consumption even drops joule heating, and it prevents heart problems.

Hall Sensor: Free Bed Selection BLTouch does not use either optical or proximity(inductive/capacitive) sensors. BLTouch is controlled by the hall effect, providing high precision. Thus, the bed material can be freely selected.
Optimized structure: Larger Build Size BLTouch is a small, and technology-intensive device. Build size can be set larger than other existing auto bed leveling sensors.

blocks.text: The LM35 series are precision IC temperature sensors, with an output voltage linearly proportional to the Centigrade temperature. Thus the LM35 has an advantage over linear temperature sensors calibrated in Kelvin, as the user is not required to subtract a large constant voltage from the output to obtain convenient Centigrade scaling.

name: Arduino UNO
desc: The Arduino Uno R3 is a open source microcontroller board based on the ATmega328 chip. This Board has 14 digital input/output pins, 6 analog input pins

blocks.text: The Arduino Uno R3 is a open source microcontroller board based on the ATmega328 chip. This Board has 14 digital input/output pins, 6 analog input pins, Onboard 16 MHz ceramic resonator, Port for USB connection, Onboard DC power jack, An ICSP header and a microcontroller reset button. It contains everything needed to support the microcontroller. Using the board is also very easy, simply connect it to a computer with a USB cable or power it with DC adapter or battery to get started.

The Uno differs from all preceding boards in that it does not use the FTDI USB-to-serial driver chip. Instead, it features the Atmega16U2Atmega8U2 up to version R2) programmed as a USB-to-serial converter. While the Arduino UNO can be powered via the USB connection or with an external power supply, the power source is selected automatically.

External (non-USB) power can come either from an AC-to-DC adapter (wall-wart) or battery. The adapter can be connected by plugging a 2.1mm center-positive plug into the board’s power jack. Also leads from a battery can be inserted in the Gnd and Vin pin headers of the Power connector. The board can operate on an external supply of 6 to 20 volts. If supplied with less than 7V, however, the 5V pin may supply less than five volts and the board may be unstable. If using more than 12V, the voltage regulator may overheat and damage the board. The recommended range is 5v to 12v for Arduino Uno.

blocks.text: The A4988 Driver is a compact microstepping stepper motor driver module designed to control bipolar stepper motors with smooth, precise, and efficient motion.
